overall_assessment: The paper is remarkably well-aligned with its source data. Of 162 audited claims, 149 (92%) match exactly or within rounding tolerance. The 5 discrepancies are mostly minor (rounding of range bounds, problem breakdown description). The 2 high-severity items (retry count and CTP-vs-FSN paired comparisons) need resolution before submission — either by locating the source computation or by correcting the reported values. The 7 UNVERIFIED items are mostly due to missing machine-readable source files rather than suspected errors; persisting these computations in analysis scripts would resolve them.
